title: Lab-01 candidate: cumulative evidence and models

questions.prompt: Virtual lab 1: original bounded data evidence. Authored form A. Four independently prepared cultures have input marker activities [100, 120, 140, 160] and collected fraction activities [50, 60, 70, 80] in matched arbitrary activity units, indexed in the same culture order. Each culture has two technical image fields. Channel overlap occurs within a conventional optical spot and single-label controls show cross-talk. A contaminating compartment marker is present; missing fractions and integrity measurements are absent. Calculate per-culture recovery then its equal-culture mean.

options: Overlap proves binding, so omit controls.
Correct cross-talk with single-label controls; optical overlap alone does not prove direct molecular binding.
Count eight fields as eight independently prepared cultures.

response_fields.prompt: Calculate equal-culture mean marker recovery as percent. Report exactly 3 significant figures.
Which next fractionation design addresses missing evidence?
options: Use only the enriched marker to declare purity.
Measure matched input, all fractions, multi-marker contamination and integrity controls; recovery is distinct from purity.
Replace input with exposure time and ignore missing fractions.
